what_happened: A reviewer read a summary from a build job that reported success for the whole monorepo, while the frontend workspace had no step at all and was never built. The dashboard showed a card count from the cached endpoint while the live endpoint returned fewer rows, and the reviewer closed the ticket before anyone compared them.
evidence: Pipeline log with one green line and no per-workspace results.
cause: The summary line was accepted as coverage without reading the list underneath it.
prevention: Require the list of workspaces in every summary line before the summary counts.
proposal: Ask for the list of workspaces and cases in each summary line and reject summaries that leave a workspace out. The reviewer also compares the cached count with the live endpoint before closing the ticket.
general_rule: test output counts as evidence only if it names what ran and what was skipped
